Messages.Body:
J Dyes wrote:
>
> ok, so Sight Beyond Sight says "put one a salubri you control, that
> salubri gets +1 intercept"...so do i still have the intercept if I
> change the clan of aforementioned salubri with a clan impersonation?

No. The Salubri gets +1 intercept. The Nosferatu (or whatever other
clan the vampire becomes) doesn't.
